class.name: amr_navigation/SlopeLayer
class.description: Prices terrain gradient from a static elevation field. Slopes below free_angle_degrees cost nothing, slopes in between are charged on a configurable curve so ramps are avoided when a flat route exists, and slopes beyond the robot's climbing ability are lethal.

class.name: amr_navigation/FleetTrajectoryLayer
class.description: Writes peer robots' predicted future positions into the local costmap with cost decaying over the prediction horizon, so the local planner routes around where other robots are about to be.
